articulation.alt: photo: /f/ → /oʊ/ → /t/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
